description: Daylight saving time transitions — Daylight saving time facts for any IANA time zone and year: whether the zone observes DST, standard and daylight UTC offsets, every transition (UTC instant, local wall time before and after, abbreviations, skipped or repeated period), whether DST is in effect now and the next transition with days until it. Handles southern-hemisphere and 30-minute zones. Params: tz= (required), year= (1971-2100, default this year). Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_dst
